enrichment.headline: Adds $558,729.45 and three years to Softchoice's districtwide Microsoft software licenses
enrichment.summary: This amendment extends the district's Microsoft software license agreement with Softchoice from October 23, 2022 to October 23, 2025. It allows up to $186,243.15 per year, or up to $558,729.45 over the three new years. That raises the agreement's spending cap from $466,138.35 to $1,024,867.80.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.title: Amendment No. 1, Microsoft Volume Licensing Enrollment for Education Solutions Agreement - Softchoice, Inc. - Technology Services Department

enrichment.headline: Accepts $280,000 from Alameda County Health Care Services Agency for nutrition education and obesity prevention
enrichment.summary: This amendment to an existing master contract has the Alameda County Health Care Services Agency provide $280,000 in funding for Nutrition Education and Obesity Prevention Programs. The programs run through the district's Community Schools and Student Services Department from October 1, 2022 through September 30, 2023.

vendor.name: Alameda County Health Care Services Agency

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.title: Amendment, Community-Based Organization (CBO) Master Contract Exhibit Coversheet - Alameda County Health Care Services Agency - Nutrition Education and Obesity Prevention Program - Community Schools and Student Services Department

enrichment.headline: Accepts $227,000 grant from First Five of Alameda County for kindergarten readiness and summer pre-K
enrichment.summary: The district accepts a $227,000 grant from First Five of Alameda County to prepare children for kindergarten. The money supports Summer Pre-K programs, gives early childhood and K-12 teachers training on the summer model, and pays a Kindergarten Readiness Director to build year-round readiness and transition programs for families. The grant covers July 1, 2022 through June 30, 2023.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.title: First 5 (Five) of Alameda County - Contract for Services - Kindergarten Readiness - Neighborhoods Ready for School - Summer Learning Programs - Community Schools and Student Services Department

enrichment.headline: Pays Bay Area Community Resources up to $112,000 to place Climate Corps fellows in the district
enrichment.summary: Bay Area Community Resources will place Climate Corps AmeriCorps Fellows in the district to work on sustainability projects. These include programs that save energy, water and waste, teaching students, and writing greenhouse gas inventories and climate action plans. The agreement runs September 1, 2022 through June 30, 2023 and is funded by the City of Oakland.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.title: Services Agreement 2022-2023 - Bay Area Community Resources - Community Schools and Student Services Department

enrichment.headline: Ratifies up to $90,000 for Saving Shorty to provide a calming staff presence on campuses
enrichment.summary: Saving Shorty will provide staff who are present on campuses the district chooses during passing periods and breaks. The goal is to help students and staff feel safe and to support calm, violence-free transitions. The agreement started August 8, 2022, before this approval, and runs through December 31, 2022.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.title: Services Agreement 2022-2023 - Saving Shorty - Community Schools and Student Services Department

enrichment.headline: Ratifies up to $93,600 for a contractor to run arts enrichment and Saturday camps for elementary students
enrichment.summary: An individual contractor will work with the Expanded Learning Office on an arts enrichment effort (theater, culinary and music) supporting all 51 district elementary schools. The contractor will also schedule nine-hour Saturday camps for 100+ students per event and manage the Salesforce Trailhead professional development platform. The agreement runs September 1, 2022 through June 30, 2023, and the board is approving it after it began.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.title: Services Agreement 2022-2023 - Trina Fields - Community Schools and Student Services Department

enrichment.headline: Ratifies up to $67,980 for Hatchuel Tabernik & Associates to help plan two after-school grant applications
enrichment.summary: Hatchuel Tabernik & Associates will provide planning help for two grant applications, the 21st Century Community Learning Centers (21st CCLC) grant and the ASSETS grant. The work is for the Community Schools and Student Services Department and runs September 2, 2022 through June 30, 2023. The board is approving it after it began.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.title: Services Agreement 2022-2023 - Hatchuel Tabernik & Associates, Inc - Community Schools and Student Services Department

enrichment.headline: Ratifies up to $19,000 for HERO to lead organized recess games at East Oakland Pride Elementary
enrichment.summary: HERO will run organized recess games and physical activity sessions and give extra support during recess at East Oakland Pride Elementary School. The agreement runs September 8, 2022 through November 30, 2022. The board is approving it after it began.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.title: Services Agreement 2022-2023 - HERO - Community Schools and Student Services Department

enrichment.headline: Adds $160,500 to Springboard Collaborative's after-school literacy program at three elementary schools
enrichment.summary: This amendment adds $160,500 to the Springboard Collaborative contract, raising its spending cap from $1,564,540 to $1,725,040. Springboard provides an eight-week after-school small-group reading program for fifty students at each of three schools, with family engagement, incentives and staff training. The contract period is May 15, 2020 through February 20, 2023.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.title: Amendment No. 4, Professional Services Contract 2019-2020 - Springboard Collaborative - Elementary Literacy Intervention Services - Community Schools and Student Services Department

enrichment.headline: Ratifies up to $37,500 for Be the Change Consulting to facilitate the George Floyd Resolution Team
enrichment.summary: Be the Change Consulting will lead monthly meetings of the George Floyd Resolution Team, including preparing agendas, tools and supporting materials. The agreement runs August 1, 2022 through December 30, 2022. The board is approving it after it began.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.title: Services Agreement 2022-2023 - Be the Change Consulting - Community Schools and Student Services Department

enrichment.headline: Ratifies up to $89,000 for a consultant to manage the rollout of Frontline systems for the Talent Division
enrichment.summary: An individual consultant will provide 1,000 hours of project management for the Frontline Implementation Project. The work includes coordinating planning sessions, writing communications and training materials, and supporting employees and supervisors after the rollout. The agreement runs July 5, 2022 through June 30, 2023. The board is approving it after it began.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.title: Services Agreement 2022-2023 - Myrna Wright - Talent / Human Resources Department

enrichment.headline: Ratifies up to $22,000 for a coach to help teachers prepare for the edTPA and CalTPA assessments
enrichment.summary: An individual contractor will lead overview sessions for small groups of teachers and coach them as they prepare to submit the edTPA or CalTPA, two teacher performance assessments. The contractor will also track progress and meet monthly with the New Teacher Support & Development team. The agreement runs July 1, 2022 through June 30, 2023. The board is approving it after it began.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.title: Services Agreement 2022-2023 - Nadja Conway - Talent / Human Resources Department

enrichment.headline: Ratifies up to $30,000 for GIBCO Environmental Service to clean up and sample environmental hazards at schools
enrichment.summary: GIBCO Environmental Service will provide environmental services to reduce risk at school sites, including environmental clean-up and collecting environmental samples. The work is managed by the Risk Management Department and runs July 1, 2022 through June 30, 2023. The board is approving it after it began.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.title: Services Agreement 2022-2023 - GIBCO Environmental Service - Risk Management Department

enrichment.headline: Approves up to $234,000 for Crisis Prevention Institute staff training, skipping public bidding
enrichment.summary: The district is buying 500 Verbal Intervention licenses, five on-site Nonviolent Crisis Response trainings for up to 40 people each, and eight slots to train OUSD staff as trainers for new hires. The district is using a sole source exception to public bidding, which means it is not seeking competing bids because it names Crisis Prevention Institute as the only provider. The agreement runs October 6, 2022 through December 31, 2023.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.title: Sole Source Exemption to Public Bidding and Resolution No. 2223-0007 - Crisis Prevention Institute (CPI) - Special Education Department

enrichment.headline: Approves out-of-state trip for four Oakland High people to a Grantmakers for Education conference at no cost
enrichment.summary: Oakland High School may send 2 twelfth-grade students and 2 adults to the Grantmakers for Education Conference in Austin, Texas, from October 18 through October 20, 2022. The trip is at no cost to the district.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.title: Student Travel - Grantmakers for Education Conference - Austin Texas - Oakland High School

enrichment.headline: Finds that using the former Parker School for adult and career education is exempt from environmental review
enrichment.summary: This resolution finds that the plan to use the former Parker School facilities for Oakland Adult and Career Education is exempt from review under the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA). It also directs the Superintendent or her designee to prepare and file a Notice of Exemption. No dollar amount is stated.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.title: Former Parker School Facilities - CEQA Exemption - Chief Governance Officer

enrichment.headline: Ratifies the Board President's appointment of a new member to the Audit Committee
enrichment.summary: The Board ratifies the Board President's appointment of Jeffrey Hall, in his first term, to the Audit Committee. The appointment takes effect October 7, 2022 and fills an unexpired term ending January 31, 2024.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.title: Appointment - Jeffrey Hall - Audit Committee - President, Board of Education
